derivation_contract.profile_arrays_binary_order: standard incident_par; standard absorbed_par; quality incident_par; quality absorbed_par
derivation_contract.summation: IEEE-754 binary64 math.fsum in declared band, plant, and level order

display_model.u_equals_one_meaning: Expected-equivalent exposure for the same canonical local patch under the fixed neutral upper-hemisphere calibration; not a leaf target and not raw-q uniformity.

front_palette.selection_basis: Calibration-only outward-rounded envelope: minimum p01, p05, p10 and maximum p95, p99, p99.9 across Standard and Quality front incident/absorbed neutral residuals. Held-out systems were not used to choose anchors.

implementation_requirements.area_weighted_revalidation: Use canonical one-sided patch areas in repository tests and metadata clipping summaries. The evidence in this input reports topology-slot/patch-count fractions because area bytes were not part of the supplied archive.
implementation_requirements.metadata_must_state_patch_specific_physi: A single physical q threshold no longer exists for a front u anchor because q_anchor[k] = u_anchor * gamma[k] * R.

limitations: Direct and Rigorous remain declared quality-family proxies.
Local-patch normalization removes fixed morphology response but intentionally preserves plant-position, occlusion, and directional-lighting differences.
Back receiver calibration and palette are intentionally deferred.

absorbed_par.derivation: held Quality-500 plant-mean local-patch response divided by achieved Stage A reference

incident_par.derivation: held Quality-500 plant-mean local-patch response divided by achieved Stage A reference

absorbed_par.derivation: five-level through-origin fit of plant-mean local-patch response against achieved Stage A reference

incident_par.derivation: five-level through-origin fit of plant-mean local-patch response against achieved Stage A reference

reference_contract.evaluated_run_R_policy: unchanged from Phase 27G-D2: requested Stage A target for target-controlled runs; achieved plant-free Stage A mean for fixed-output runs

scientific_intent: Remove fixed canonical local-patch morphology response from display normalization while preserving inter-plant and spatial lighting-system differences.
scope: front receiver surface only; backside behavior intentionally deferred and unchanged

spectral_contract.incident_equation: sum of four PAR band receiver densities
